prompt:
There is no way to add a new project in Qwobolt at all right now, and I need one. Someone should be able to point it at a folder and run their first task in it.

Keep it as plain HTML and JS in a single app.html — no build step, I just open it in a browser. Copy app.html into your output folder and work there. Save every file you touch.
assertions: A journey card is written before the UI code, listing the steps only the person can supply and how many steps that comes to.
The action for adding a project appears on the view that lists projects, not only behind Search or in Settings.
A newly added project can be opened and used in the running app with no page reload, no app restart and no 'Refresh to apply' step.
A newly added project gets the provider already signed in, so its first task starts through startTask with no per-project provider step and no trip to Settings.
Text typed in the composer is still there after a failure, a decline or a detour.
Errors shown by the flow name their cause and the next action; no generic copy such as 'Something went wrong' or 'Please try again'.
The finished work reports a friction scorecard with the friction ratio, the friction score, each friction event with its loss class and weight, and any budget failures.
